fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: family_id
fields.meaning: Model: the brand's page or code that groups the colours and sizes of one model.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Item name in English, as the brand writes it.

fields.name: name_en
fields.meaning: Display name used on English-language cards.

fields.name: name_en_source
fields.meaning: Origin of the display name used on English-language cards.

fields.name: name_lang
fields.meaning: Language of the name (en, pt, es, de, fr, it, zh, ko, ja…); may differ from text_lang.

fields.name: sold_per_unit
fields.meaning: True when the brand sells the item per unit (single earrings, studs, cufflinks).

fields.name: name_local
fields.meaning: Item name in the language of the local storefront, when a local version exists.

fields.name: text_lang
fields.meaning: Language of the item's description (ISO 639-1).

fields.name: text_source_region
fields.meaning: Storefront the text comes from; English storefronts are preferred.

fields.name: department
fields.meaning: Department code; see the department table for its name and order.

fields.name: department_raw
fields.meaning: Department as the brand's storefront groups the item.

fields.name: category
fields.meaning: Category within the department, in English, one name per department; the storefront's own name is in category_raw.

fields.name: category_raw
fields.meaning: Category exactly as the brand's storefront names it (e.g. "Shoulder bags", "Boots", "Calças").

fields.name: category_source
fields.meaning: Category origin as reported in the data.

fields.name: collection
fields.meaning: The brand's named line, as the brand shows it.

fields.name: campaign
fields.meaning: Campaigns featuring the item, such as gift guides, seasonal capsules and collaborations (list).

fields.name: season
fields.meaning: Show or collection season: "Fall-Winter 2026", "Spring-Summer 2026", "Pre-Fall 2026".

fields.name: product_type
fields.meaning: Type of item in English (sneaker, ankle boot, tote, card holder, bracelet, belt, watch strap…), for filtering.

fields.name: product_type_raw
fields.meaning: Type of item exactly as the brand's storefront names it, only when it differs from product_type (e.g. "knitwear" → sweater).

fields.name: audience
fields.meaning: Who the item is for: Women, Men, Unisex or Kids, as the brand labels it or as its menu, name or description states it.

fields.name: audience_source
fields.meaning: Where the audience comes from: the brand's product data, the storefront menu or category, the item name, or the description.

fields.name: material
fields.meaning: Material in English; several differing values are joined by " · ".

fields.name: material_source
fields.meaning: Where the material comes from: the product page, the brand's material code, the line under the name, or the item name.

fields.name: material_all
fields.meaning: All material values as published, by source (for reference; API only).

fields.name: composition
fields.meaning: Fibre composition as a list of {fiber, pct}, e.g. from "57% Wool, 25% Cashmere…".

fields.name: composition_secondary
fields.meaning: Secondary materials: "Lining: 100% Polyamide · Other: Lamb" (lining, inserts, other).

fields.name: material_local
fields.meaning: Material in the language of the local storefront (only when the text is not English).

fields.name: material_line
fields.meaning: The brand's named material line (a signature canvas or leather), only when the item is made of it: a print of the line's motif on cotton is not the line.

fields.name: color
fields.meaning: Colour in English.

fields.name: color_all
fields.meaning: All differing colour values as published (for reference).

fields.name: color_group
fields.meaning: Colour group for the filter, one of 16 values (Black, White, Brown, Beige, Grey, Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, Gold, Silver, Multicolor, Natural).

fields.name: color_groups
fields.meaning: All colour groups of a two-tone item ("Black / White" → [Black, White]); the item is found under each.

fields.name: color_group_lv
fields.meaning: The brand's own colour group, mapped to the same 16 groups (Preto / 블랙 / ブラック → Black); shown next to color_group on the card, while the filter uses color_group.

fields.name: color_group_differs
fields.meaning: True when color_group and the brand's own colour group (color_group_lv) are both present and differ (e.g. White against the brand's Beige); false otherwise, including when one of them is empty.

fields.name: customizable
fields.meaning: The item can be personalised; no colour applies.

fields.name: color_local
fields.meaning: Shade in the language of the local storefront (only when the text is not English).

fields.name: made_in
fields.meaning: Country or countries of manufacture in English, e.g. "Italy" or "France · Spain · Italy".

fields.name: made_in_countries
fields.meaning: Countries of manufacture as ISO 3166 codes (list, same order as made_in) — a filter.

fields.name: made_in_all
fields.meaning: For reference: [countries from the storefront's made-in field, countries from the description], in English.

fields.name: made_in_multi_country
fields.meaning: True when more than one country of manufacture is stated.

fields.name: made_in_raw
fields.meaning: The country-of-manufacture phrase exactly as published on the storefront.

fields.name: description
fields.meaning: Marketing description in the brand's words; sizes, dimensions, care and "Made in" are in their own fields.

fields.name: description_short
fields.meaning: The brand's short blurb — the opening text of the card; in lists it stands in for the description.

fields.name: description_short_redundant
fields.meaning: True when the description contains the whole short blurb (then it is not shown separately).

fields.name: description_local
fields.meaning: Description in the language of the local storefront.

fields.name: description_en_source
fields.meaning: Where the English description comes from: the item's own page, the English page of the same model (the colour may differ), or an earlier week.

fields.name: text_source_snapshot
fields.meaning: Week the English text is from, when it is older than this week: the latest page had no English, so description, features and care come from that week.

fields.name: carried_fields
fields.meaning: Text fields taken from an earlier week: description · features · care.

fields.name: description_en_from
fields.meaning: Article whose English page the description comes from.

fields.name: dimensions_raw
fields.meaning: Dimensions as published on the storefront ("29 x 17.5 x 10 cm", "33.5 x 45.3 x 23.6 inches").

fields.name: dimensions_unit_raw
fields.meaning: Unit of the published dimensions (cm, inches, mm).

fields.name: dim_axes
fields.meaning: Labels of the dimensions, e.g. L×W or D×H.

fields.name: dim_length_cm
fields.meaning: Length in centimetres (converted when published in inches or millimetres).

fields.name: dim_height_cm
fields.meaning: Height in centimetres.

fields.name: dim_width_cm
fields.meaning: Width or depth in centimetres; for round items the diameter.

fields.name: dim_length_in
fields.meaning: Length in inches (centimetres / 2.54).

fields.name: dim_height_in
fields.meaning: Height in inches.

fields.name: dim_width_in
fields.meaning: Width in inches.

fields.name: names_by_lang
fields.meaning: The brand's own name for the item in each storefront language, as published (ISO 639-1 → list of names); the English name is in name_en.

fields.name: dimensions_by_size
fields.meaning: Dimensions per size as the brand lists them in the description (trunks and luggage, books, sets), e.g. {"50": "50 x 18 x 37 cm"}.

fields.name: heel_height_cm
fields.meaning: Heel height in centimetres ("Heel, 4.5cm/1.8 inch").

fields.name: platform_height_cm
fields.meaning: Platform or sole height in centimetres.

fields.name: belt_width_mm
fields.meaning: Belt width in millimetres, from the name ("40mm Reversible Belt").

fields.name: case_diameter_mm
fields.meaning: Watch case diameter in millimetres, from the name (e.g. "…, 44mm, steel").

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.meaning: Weight in kilograms.

fields.name: diamond_count
fields.meaning: Number of diamonds (other stones are not counted).

fields.name: diamond_carat_total
fields.meaning: Total diamond weight in carats, the centre stone included when it is a diamond; other stones are not included.

fields.name: diamond_color_grade
fields.meaning: Diamond colour grade (GIA), e.g. "D to G".

fields.name: metal_fineness
fields.meaning: Metal fineness: 750 (18 kt), 925 (silver), 950 (platinum).

fields.name: gold_karat
fields.meaning: Gold purity in carats (e.g. 18), only when gold is the main material (not a buckle or hands).

fields.name: gold_fineness
fields.meaning: Gold fineness (750).

fields.name: is_platinum
fields.meaning: True when platinum is the material.

fields.name: specs_raw
fields.meaning: The page's specifications as published (JSON), API only.

fields.name: unparsed
fields.meaning: Additional details in the brand's own wording, as "label: value" lines.

fields.name: features
fields.meaning: Features in the brand's own words, one per line, as listed on the product page (materials, hardware, closures, pockets, fit); the marketing text is in description.

fields.name: care
fields.meaning: Care instructions supplied by the house, when available.

fields.name: features_local
fields.meaning: Features in the language of the local storefront, when they are not in English; features is then empty and features_lang names the language.

fields.name: care_local
fields.meaning: Care lines in the language of the local storefront that have no English version; care holds the English lines.

fields.name: features_lang
fields.meaning: Language of the features and care text.

fields.name: sustainability
fields.meaning: Responsible-sourcing notes from the brand's sustainability section (Leather Working Group tanneries, Responsible Jewellery Council, Kimberley Process, origin).

fields.name: features_source
fields.meaning: Origin of the feature list.

fields.name: size_run
fields.meaning: Sizes listed on the item page, labels as sold, for items whose sizes are not in size_variant.

fields.name: size_run_region
fields.meaning: Storefront the size list comes from (its country's size scale applies).

fields.name: size_scale
fields.meaning: Size scale of the item: EU · US · UK · cm · inches · alpha · ring · ml · months · years · one_size · numeric · other.

fields.name: lv_url
fields.meaning: Link to the item on the brand's site: an English storefront where the page is live, otherwise a local one; see lv_url_status and page_checked_snapshot.

fields.name: page_checked_snapshot
fields.meaning: Week the link was last checked.

fields.name: lv_url_status
fields.meaning: Link status: alive — live this week · repointed — points to another storefront where the page is live · gone_all — not found on any storefront at the latest check · unverified — not confirmed live this week · none — no link known.

fields.name: lv_url_region
fields.meaning: Storefront the link points to.

fields.name: record_completeness
fields.meaning: How much item detail is available.

fields.name: family_alias_of
fields.meaning: Main article of the same product, listed by the brand under another code on another model page.

fields.name: duplicate_of
fields.meaning: Main article, when this record is a second listing of the same product under another code.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Listing status: in_catalog, e1_only or gone. Delisted does not mean discontinued.

fields.name: status_as_of
fields.meaning: Last week the item was seen; for delisted items, the week it was last seen ("delisted as of").

fields.name: regions_present
fields.meaning: Number of storefronts with a recorded listing.

fields.name: regions_observed
fields.meaning: Number of storefronts where listing was observed.

fields.name: regions_declared
fields.meaning: Number of storefronts reported by the house.

fields.name: weeks_unlisted
fields.meaning: Consecutive weeks without a listing or price.

fields.name: regions_with_price
fields.meaning: Number of storefronts with a current price (0 = no prices).

fields.name: price_usd_ref
fields.meaning: USD price for lists: the median of current prices across countries (two storefronts of one country count once).

fields.name: price_ref_countries
fields.meaning: Number of countries with a current price (the USD price is the median across them).

fields.name: price_ref_single_market
fields.meaning: True when the price is known in one country only: the USD price is that storefront's price, not a median across markets.

fields.name: price_ref_country
fields.meaning: ISO code of that single country when price_ref_single_market is true; otherwise empty.

fields.name: countries_present
fields.meaning: Number of countries with a recorded listing.

fields.name: countries_observed
fields.meaning: Number of countries where listing was observed.

fields.name: countries_declared
fields.meaning: Number of countries reported by the house.

fields.name: countries_with_price
fields.meaning: Number of countries with a current price (same as price_ref_countries).

fields.name: last_price_countries
fields.meaning: Number of countries with a price in the last week with a price (goes with price_usd_last).

fields.name: price_usd_fr
fields.meaning: Price on the French storefront in USD (EU price incl. VAT 20%).

fields.name: price_usd_us
fields.meaning: Price on the US storefront in USD (excl. sales tax).

fields.name: price_usd_min
fields.meaning: Lowest price across storefronts in USD (on the card).

fields.name: price_usd_max
fields.meaning: Highest price across storefronts in USD (on the card).

fields.name: weeks_of_history
fields.meaning: Number of weeks with a price on at least one storefront.

fields.name: price_events
fields.meaning: Number of weeks in which the price changed on at least one storefront.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week the item was seen: listed on a storefront, live at its address, priced, or on a product page.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the item was seen (see Status names).

fields.name: price_usd_last
fields.meaning: Last known USD price: the median across countries in the last week with a price; equals price_usd_ref for items with a price this week.

fields.name: last_price_snapshot
fields.meaning: Week of the last known price.

fields.name: last_price_regions
fields.meaning: Number of storefronts with a price in that week.

fields.name: sellable_anywhere
fields.meaning: True when at least one storefront showing the item this week offers it for online purchase.

fields.name: regions_present_ex_e1
fields.meaning: Number of country storefronts that showed the item (see Status names), not counting the international storefront.

fields.name: photos_ever
fields.meaning: How many photos the gallery has ever had, including photos the brand later removed (see image.last_seen).

fields.name: photos
fields.meaning: Number of photos in the current gallery, as shown on the brand's page.

fields.name: photos_additional
fields.meaning: Number of further photos of the item that the brand has but does not show on its page; not included in photos.

fields.name: videos
fields.meaning: Number of distinct videos.

fields.name: audience
fields.meaning: Who the item is for: Women, Men, Unisex or Kids, as the brand labels it or as its menu, name or description states it.

fields.name: variants_n
fields.meaning: Number of variation codes (sizes, colours or materials without a card of their own) that belong to this card (see article_variant).

fields.name: variants_countries_n
fields.meaning: Number of countries whose storefronts listed the variations; they count for the main card.

fields.name: variants_last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week any variation was seen.

fields.name: department
fields.meaning: Department code (as in product_client).

fields.name: department_en
fields.meaning: Department name.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.meaning: Display order in navigation.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (language_country, e.g. eng_NL): the brand's site for one country and language; see the region table for the country.

fields.name: country
fields.meaning: Country of the storefront.

fields.name: language
fields.meaning: Language of the storefront (ISO 639).

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the storefront (ISO 4217).

fields.name: is_international
fields.meaning: True for an international storefront without a country (no prices).

fields.name: price_includes_tax
fields.meaning: True when storefront prices include tax (VAT/GST): EU, UK, Switzerland, Australia, Japan, China, Brazil, Mexico, Korea, UAE; false for the United States, Canada and Hong Kong.

fields.name: tax_note
fields.meaning: Tax basis in words: "incl. VAT 20%", "excl. sales tax", "no VAT or sales tax".

fields.name: coverage
fields.meaning: Coverage of the storefront's data for the week: full or partial.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: spec_key
fields.meaning: Specification key (English, e.g. strap_drop_cm, lining, w_power_reserve_h); see Specification keys.

fields.name: spec_value
fields.meaning: Value in the unit of the key (see Specification keys); local-language text is given in English where possible.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: sku
fields.meaning: SKU of the size or colour variant.

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Article the variant belongs to.

fields.name: family_id
fields.meaning: Model: the brand's page or code that groups the colours and sizes of one model.

fields.name: size_label
fields.meaning: Size label as sold: "7.5", "38", "90 cm", "One size".

fields.name: size_label_raw
fields.meaning: Label exactly as in the brand's data ("07.5", "S0", "NSA").

fields.name: variant_kind
fields.meaning: What varies: size · color (colour only) · one_size · volume (ml) · age (months).

fields.name: size_order
fields.meaning: Display order within the size run.

fields.name: size_scale
fields.meaning: Size scale of the run: EU · US · UK · cm · inches · alpha · ring · ml · months · years · one_size · numeric · other.

fields.name: scope
fields.meaning: article — a variant of this article · family — another colour of the same model; the exact article is not known.

fields.name: source_article
fields.meaning: Article whose page the variant comes from (for reference).

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront of the size; its country's size scale applies (see the region table).

fields.name: color
fields.meaning: Variant colour in English where available (Noir / Preto → Black); shade names without a translation keep the brand's wording.

fields.name: color_raw
fields.meaning: Variant colour exactly as on the storefront (for reference).

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Variant price in the storefront currency when it was seen.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the storefront (ISO 4217).

fields.name: sellable
fields.meaning: In stock on that storefront this week; never true on the international storefront.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.meaning: When this row was seen (UTC).

fields.name: lv_url
fields.meaning: Link to the variant on the brand's site.

fields.name: image_url
fields.meaning: Link to the variant photo on the brand's server, for reference only; the brand may change or remove it.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: variant_article
fields.meaning: Variation code: an article of the brand that has no card of its own (a size, colour or material of the main article).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Main article (the card this variation belongs to): "code X is the size-46 variation of Y".

fields.name: family_id
fields.meaning: Model page of the variation (see family_id in product_client).

fields.name: kind
fields.meaning: What varies: a size, a colour or finish, a metal or stone, or a part of a belt set.

fields.name: size_label
fields.meaning: Size label of the variation as sold (as in size_variant).

fields.name: color
fields.meaning: Colour of the variation in English: for a size, the colour of the main card; for a colour, its own shade.

fields.name: color_raw
fields.meaning: Colour of the variation exactly as on the storefront (for reference).

fields.name: link_source
fields.meaning: How the variation is linked to the card: a size or colour row of a card of the same model, the same model page, or the colour choice on a product page.

fields.name: regions
fields.meaning: Storefronts (region codes) that listed the variation.

fields.name: regions_n
fields.meaning: Number of such storefronts.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week a storefront listed the variation.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the variation was listed or its page was live.

fields.name: registry_status
fields.meaning: Status of the variation's pages at the latest check: alive — at least one was live · gone — none was live · unverified — not checked yet.

fields.name: lv_url
fields.meaning: Link to the variation page on the brand's site (an English storefront is preferred).

fields.name: sellable_anywhere
fields.meaning: True if a storefront showed the variation in stock this week (see size_variant).

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (language_country, e.g. eng_NL): the brand's site for one country and language; see the region table for the country.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the storefront (ISO 4217).

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Price as published on the storefront (decimal; JPY and KRW without fraction), only when price_state = current.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.meaning: Price in USD at the week's rate (the last ECB rate before the week); empty when price_state is not current (see last_price_usd).

fields.name: price_eur
fields.meaning: Price in EUR at the week's rate; empty when price_state is not current.

fields.name: availability
fields.meaning: Availability on the storefront: sellable · no · backorder · InStoreOnly · not_sold_online · empty (not reported by the storefront).

fields.name: observed_at
fields.meaning: When the observation was made (UTC).

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: Week of the observations (ISO week), e.g. 2026-W36.

fields.name: is_latest_run
fields.meaning: true — the price is current (price_state = current); false — no current price: price is empty, price_state says why, and the last known price is in last_price*.

fields.name: price_state
fields.meaning: Whether the price is current, no longer shown, or awaiting an update.

fields.name: last_checked_week
fields.meaning: Last week this storefront was checked for the item (with or without a price).

fields.name: last_price
fields.meaning: Last known price on this storefront, given when price_state is not current (the price fields are then empty).

fields.name: last_price_currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the last known price (the storefront currency).

fields.name: last_price_usd
fields.meaning: Last known price in USD at the rate of its own week.

fields.name: last_price_snapshot
fields.meaning: Week of the last known price (equals snapshot_id of this row).

fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (language_country, e.g. eng_NL): the brand's site for one country and language; see the region table for the country.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: Week of the observation.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the storefront (ISO 4217).

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Price as published on the storefront.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.meaning: Price in USD at the week's rate.

fields.name: availability
fields.meaning: Availability on the storefront (see price_current).

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Where the price was read: the product page, a listing page, the brand's price list, or the China storefront page.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.meaning: When the observation was made (UTC).

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (language_country, e.g. eng_NL): the brand's site for one country and language; see the region table for the country.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Where the listing was seen: the storefront's site map, the item page, a listing page, or the brand's own data and links.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: Week of the observations (ISO week), e.g. 2026-W36.

fields.name: present
fields.meaning: True = listed on the storefront, false = not listed.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.meaning: When the observation was made (UTC).

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (language_country, e.g. eng_NL): the brand's site for one country and language; see the region table for the country.

fields.name: present
fields.meaning: Latest known state; a live page counts over a listing.

fields.name: basis
fields.meaning: What the listing rests on: observed — we saw the item on this storefront (item page, site map, listing or price) · declared — only linked by the brand from another storefront; not seen there.

fields.name: counted
fields.meaning: True when this storefront counts in the item's storefront numbers: present, and seen recently enough (this week, unless stated below).

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week the item was listed on this storefront.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the item was listed on this storefront.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: Week of the latest observation.

fields.name: is_latest_run
fields.meaning: True if the observation is from this week.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Article (the brand's reference code).

fields.name: region
fields.meaning: Storefront code (as in price_current and region).

fields.name: source_url
fields.meaning: Link to the item page on this storefront; the brand may change or remove it.

fields.name: url_status
fields.meaning: alive — the page was at this address this week · gone — no page at the latest check · unknown — not checked this week; show the link only for alive.

fields.name: checked_week
fields.meaning: Week the address was last checked (show as "checked in week …").

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week the address was seen.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the address was seen or live.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: seq
fields.meaning: Order of the view; 1 = the main photo.

fields.name: view
fields.meaning: View as the brand names it, e.g. Front view · Side view · Interior view · Worn view · Back view · Detail view.

fields.name: media_ref
fields.meaning: A stable identifier of the image; the same image keeps it across exports.

fields.name: width
fields.meaning: Width of the original photo in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.meaning: Height of the original photo in pixels.

fields.name: has_alpha
fields.meaning: Whether the original has a transparent background (true for PNG with transparency).

fields.name: bytes
fields.meaning: Size of the original file in bytes.

fields.name: is_capped
fields.meaning: True when the stored original is the largest image the brand provides and it is below full resolution.

fields.name: frame_source
fields.meaning: Where the photo comes from: shown on the storefront page, the brand's own photo not shown on its page (not counted in photos), or kept from an earlier week.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week the photo was in the gallery (photos from before 2026-W24 are dated 2026-W24).

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the photo was in the gallery.

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Item reference code, used together with the house identifier.

fields.name: seq
fields.meaning: Order of the clip on the item page (1 = first).

fields.name: media_ref
fields.meaning: A stable identifier of the clip; the same clip keeps it across exports.

fields.name: bytes
fields.meaning: File size in bytes.

fields.name: mime
fields.meaning: File type (video/mp4).

fields.name: duration_s
fields.meaning: Duration in seconds.

fields.name: width
fields.meaning: Frame width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.meaning: Frame height in pixels.

fields.name: source_url
fields.meaning: The clip's address on the brand's server, for reference only.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.meaning: First week the clip was attached to the item.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.meaning: Last week the clip was listed for the item.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: Week of the observations (ISO week), e.g. 2026-W36.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Currency of the storefront (ISO 4217).

fields.name: units_per_usd
fields.meaning: Units of the currency per 1 USD in the week (JPY 156.25): price_usd = price / units_per_usd.

fields.name: units_per_eur
fields.meaning: Units of the currency per 1 EUR (from the same rates): price_eur = price / units_per_eur.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Reference used for the currency conversion rate.

fields.name: as_of
fields.meaning: When the rate was recorded (UTC).

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.meaning: ISO week of the observations.

fields.name: started_at
fields.meaning: When observations for the week started.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.meaning: When observations for the week finished.

fields.name: health_status
fields.meaning: Completeness of the week's data: ok — complete · suspect — looks incomplete (for example far fewer items than usual).

fields.name: brand
fields.meaning: House identifier.

fields.name: brand_name_en
fields.meaning: Brand name in English for the brand code (Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermès, …).

fields.name: article
fields.meaning: Article of the brand's demo set.

fields.name: roles
fields.meaning: Properties the item demonstrates: price_event · gone · maturing (Not listed this week, with a last known price) · price_spread · e1_only · video · family_size · alnum_code (letters and digits in the code) · price_ladder_top (top of the price range).

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Status this week (see Status names).

fields.name: price_events
fields.meaning: Price changes in the history.

fields.name: price_spread_ratio
fields.meaning: Highest to lowest USD price across storefronts.

fields.name: videos
fields.meaning: Videos.

fields.name: family_size
fields.meaning: Articles on the same model page.

fields.name: checks_ok
fields.meaning: True when the item still shows every property it was chosen for this week.

fields.name: checks_failed
fields.meaning: Properties this item no longer demonstrates.
